findings: The book says Cd2+ replaces Ca2+ because of 'higher charge density'; both are 2+ ions and Cd2+ (about 95 pm) is slightly smaller than Ca2+ (about 100 pm), so this holds, though the printed sketch exaggerates the size difference. Explained in the Roman Urdu tip under the figure.
The book calls pesticides 'such as DDT and Glyphosate' non-polar and insoluble in water; glyphosate is polar and water-soluble. Noted in a warning; flagged for review.
